articles.headline: FIFA accuses UEFA of 'smear campaign' in opposing discovery request
articles.description: FIFA accused European soccer body UEFA of a "smear campaign" in a court filing Thursday concerning FIFA president Gianni Infantino's failed plan to sell stakes in the World Cup and other competitions.

articles.headline: Socceroos transfer tracker: Where Australia's stars will play in 2026-27
articles.description: Transfer deadlines are hitting across the globe and, with it, bringing to an end a window that has seen a remarkable surge in interest in players who represented the Socceroos at the FIFA World Cup.

articles.headline: Kushner says he regrets role in FIFA's World Cup sell-off plan
articles.description: FIFA's intended investment partner, Josh Kushner, said he regrets getting involved in Gianni Infantino's failed World Cup sell-off plan.
